description: Bar-Mode Selector UI - Wire ChartBarMode into the chart with a dropdown/chip in the toolbar, apply HeikinAshi/Renko transforms before indicators, and hide SMC overlays when preservesTimeAxis is false.
steps: Add barMode: ChartBarMode = ChartBarMode.TIME and renkoSize: Double = 10.0 to ChartUiState data class
Add a bar-mode dropdown/chip in ChartScreen toolbar (next to the timeframe selector in ChartToolbar) showing Time/Heikin-Ashi/Renko options
Add onBarModeChange(barMode: ChartBarMode) and onRenkoSizeChange(size: Double) functions to ChartViewModel

In ChartViewModel/ChartDataController pipeline (processCandles), apply the bar-mode transform AFTER loading candles but BEFORE passing to indicators: val displayCandles = when (barMode) { TIME -> candles; HEIKIN_ASHI -> heikinAshiTransformer.transform(candles); RENKO -> candleRenkoBuilder.build(candles, renkoSize) }
Inject HeikinAshiTransformer + CandleRenkoBuilder into ChartViewModel (add to constructor parameters)
When barMode.preservesTimeAxis == false, set SMC overlays (orderBlocks, fairValueGaps, liquidityPools, structureBreaks) to empty in the ChartUiStateMapper (withComputation function)
Update CandleChart parameters to accept and pass through barMode for any needed rendering adjustments
acceptance_criteria: ChartUiState has barMode and renkoSize fields with correct defaults
ChartScreen toolbar shows a bar-mode selector with Time/Heikin-Ashi/Renko options
ChartViewModel applies HeikinAshiTransformer.transform() when barMode == HEIKIN_ASHI
ChartViewModel applies CandleRenkoBuilder.build() when barMode == RENKO
SMC overlays (orderBlocks, FVG, liquidity, structure) are hidden (empty) when barMode.preservesTimeAxis == false
HeikinAshiTransformer and CandleRenkoBuilder are injected into ChartViewModel
verification: Source-level verification: confirm transform logic is in processCandles pipeline, overlays gated by preservesTimeAxis, and new UI element exists in ChartScreen
findings: ChartBarMode enum, HeikinAshiTransformer, and CandleRenkoBuilder were not pre-existing and had to be created as part of this feature. They live at domain/model/ChartBarMode.kt and domain/usecase/chart/{HeikinAshiTransformer,CandleRenkoBuilder}.kt. Both transformers are @Singleton @Inject for Hilt constructor injection. The BarModeDropdown uses the same FlowRow chip pattern as TimeframeDropdown. SMC gating in ChartUiStateMapper uses a barMode parameter with default TIME for backward compatibility. The toolbar now has a bar-mode chip that shows the current mode label between Timeframe and Indicators chips.
